sources.observation: Tall brick walls have pale stone cross-mullions, asymmetrical stepped-gable dormers, slate slopes, carved emblems and formal hedges around a low wellhead.

sources.credit: WhichMuseum exterior reference, photo credit on page.
sources.observation: Warm limestone walls, segmental three-storey windows, a dark portal below the shallow pediment, and curved dormers establish the Vrijdagmarkt frontage.

limitations: Roof and window rhythms are matched to exterior pictures. The entry ornament and garden planting are modeled interpretations. Workshops and collections inside the museum are outside the exterior scope.
